texts.name: Ranloo
texts.biography: Following a childhood dream, Ranloo became an aide at Mestley's armory. Ancient master's gift was no lore, rather a bite to the neck and a pit in the Talon woods. Undeath wasn't fun, but Ranloo's hands got as crafty as ever. Soon he was wearing Mestley's Master Blacksmith diadem after running him through with a missile from a self-designed ballista.

specialty.name: Ballista
specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Ballista by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
